reason: My diary has worked for years and I trust it more than any phone. I keep stock in my head and order from the same two or three vendors, so I don't feel a problem that needs fixing.
objection: Is 500 rupees a month worth it, and what happens after the free 3 months? I would be moving my udhaar records out of my diary into something I can't hold, and then paying every month to keep them.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work in my own shop for a few weeks, with my diary kept alongside it, and being told the exact price and what happens to my records if I stop paying.
